{{Top|leg}}
'''Shockboxing armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by combatants in the sport of [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]]. Used in conjunction with [[shockmitt]]s, the armor helped to protect the fighter from physical blows.
